info.name: SERPSpur Universal SEO & AI Intelligence API (v3.0)
info.description: Official Postman collection for all 21 live SERPSpur REST API endpoints across 7 SEO & AI Intelligence APIs. Set api_key to ss_live_sandbox_demo with mode=sandbox to test free (0 credits), or use your personal ss_live_ key from https://serpspur.com/api-docs/.

item.name: 0. Auth, Quotas & Errors
item.description: All 7 SERPSpur REST APIs share one unified gateway at https://serpspur.com/api/v1. Authenticate using Bearer Token, X-API-Key, or HTTP Basic Auth (your account email + ss_live_ API key). Every error response (4xx/5xx) and every sandbox call charges strictly 0 credits.

item.name: GET /api/v1/account — Inspect Wallet Balance, Active API Subscription & Effective Quotas

request.description:
Returns your real-time rollover credit balance, SaaS plan tier, stackable Monthly Developer API Subscription status, effective RPM/burst/live-concurrency ceilings, low-balance alert configuration, and active API key telemetry. Call this before launching large batch or 100-page crawl jobs.

Credit Cost: 0 Credits (Free)
Cache Policy: Live account state

item.name: GET /api/v1/openapi.json — Download Auto-Generated OpenAPI 3.1 Specification

request.description:
Public, unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.1 JSON document describing every SERPSpur REST API endpoint, parameter schema, authentication scheme, and server URL. Import directly into Postman, Insomnia, Swagger UI, or LLM coding assistants.

Credit Cost: 0 Credits (Public Spec)
Cache Policy: 1-Hour HTTP Cache

item.name: 1. Site Audit & Crawl API
item.description: Execute real Headless Chrome rendering on desktop or mobile viewports to measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, TTFB, FCP, TBT, INP), post-JS On-Page SEO, AI Crawler Readiness (robots.txt directives for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot + llms.txt), Security Headers, Broken Links, and async 5–100 page full-site crawls without HTTP timeouts.

item.name: GET /api/v1/audit — Single-URL Headless Chrome Technical, CWV & AI-Crawler Audit

request.description:
Audits a single URL in Headless Chrome (desktop 1366x768 or mobile 390x844). Returns 60+ technical data points across HTTP, On-Page SEO, Core Web Vitals, Page Weight, Links/Media, Security Headers, AI Crawler Readiness, and prioritized issues. Add detail=full at 0 extra credits to include deep DOM arrays (headings outline, oversized/missing-alt image URLs, raw JSON-LD, links inventory, and extracted text).

Credit Cost: Vault: 3 Cr | Live: 10 Cr | Deep (+30 Links): 20 Cr
Cache Policy: 24-Hour Shared Vault

item.name: POST /api/v1/audit/crawl — Start Async Multi-Page Full-Site Crawl (5–100 Pages)

request.description:
Dispatches a non-blocking 5–100 page Headless Chrome site crawl via sitemap discovery + internal link BFS. Returns immediately (<250ms) with a job_id and poll_url so your app never times out. Credits are reserved upfront (max_pages × 2 Cr); if the site has fewer pages than requested, unused credits are auto-refunded atomically upon completion (both when polled and via our 15-minute background reconciler cron).

Credit Cost: 2 Cr / crawled page (unused pages auto-refunded)
Cache Policy: Async Queue + Permanent Archive

item.name: GET /api/v1/audit/crawl/{job_id} — Poll Crawl Progress, Paginated JSON Report & Streaming CSV Export

request.description:
Polls a running crawl or retrieves a permanently archived completed crawl for 0 credits. Returns site-wide health rollup, cross-page duplicate title/meta clusters, AI crawler readiness, paginated per-page audits, and exact auto-refund accounting. Append ?format=csv to stream ALL crawled pages directly as an RFC-4180 CSV file.

Credit Cost: 0 Credits (Free Polling & CSV Download)
Cache Policy: Permanent DB Archive Once Completed

item.name: GET /api/v1/audit/crawls — List Past Async Site Crawl Jobs

request.description:
Returns a paginated history of all multi-page site crawl tasks created by your account, filterable by status, with ready-to-use poll_url and csv_url links.

Credit Cost: 0 Credits (Free Task History)
Cache Policy: Direct DB History

item.name: POST /api/v1/audit/batch — Batch Technical Audit Vault Lookup (Up to 50 URLs)

request.description:
Checks up to 50 URLs against the 24-hour Technical Audit Vault in a single ultra-fast request. You are charged only for cache hits; misses cost 0 credits.

Credit Cost: 3 Cr / Vault Hit (0 Cr for Misses)
Cache Policy: 24-Hour Vault Only

item.name: 2. Backlinks & Gap API
item.description: Built for link-building agencies, domain marketplaces, and SEO SaaS platforms working with sites carrying millions of backlinks. Pull full authority summaries, filter by 11 zero-surcharge criteria (CMS platform, backlink type, live/lost, min DR, max spam score, TLD, anchor, semantic HTML location), stream unlimited pages via cursor pagination, run competitor backlink gap intersections, or stream RFC-4180 CSV directly.

item.name: GET /api/v1/backlinks — Domain Authority Summary & Agency-Filtered Backlink Stream

request.description:
Retrieves normalized 0–100 Domain Rank, referring domains, dofollow ratio, spam score, CMS/TLD/country/semantic distributions, and up to 1,000 granular backlink rows per request with unlimited cursor pagination and optional CSV streaming.

Credit Cost: Vault: 8 Cr | Summary: 30 Cr | P1 1K: 110 Cr | P2+ Cursor 1K: 80 Cr
Cache Policy: 30-Day Vault (Unfiltered) / Live Filtered

item.name: POST /api/v1/backlinks/gap — Competitor Backlink Gap Intersection (1–4 Competitors)

request.description:
Finds high-authority referring domains linking to your competitors that do NOT yet link to your target domain — ranked by authority for immediate outreach prospecting.

Credit Cost: 30 Credits / Analysis
Cache Policy: Live Intersection

item.name: POST /api/v1/backlinks/batch — Batch Backlinks Vault Lookup (Up to 50 Domains)

request.description:
Screens up to 50 domains in one call against the 30-day Backlinks Vault for authority summaries. Only cache hits are billed (8 Cr/hit).

Credit Cost: 8 Cr / Vault Hit (0 Cr for Misses)
Cache Policy: 30-Day Vault Only

item.name: 3. Keyword Research API
item.description: Pull real-time search demand, 12-month seasonality trends, YoY/QoQ growth velocity, Keyword Difficulty (0–100), Top-10 referring domains & dofollow links needed to rank, commercial intent, SERP features, forum-weakness signals, and multi-depth related keyword clusters (from Seed-Only Depth 0 up to Mega 200-Keyword Depth 4).

item.name: GET /api/v1/keywords — Single Keyword Intelligence & Related Cluster Scan (Depth 0–4)

request.description:
Returns full seed keyword telemetry plus related keyword cluster sized by your chosen depth (0 = seed only, 1 = lite/top 8, 2 = standard/top 30, 3 = full/100 KWs, 4 = mega/200 KWs).

Credit Cost: Vault: 5 Cr | D0: 15 | Lite: 18 | D2: 22 | Full 100: 30 | Mega: 50 Cr
Cache Policy: 30-Day Keyword Vault

item.name: POST /api/v1/keywords/batch — Batch Keyword Intelligence (Up to 50 Vault / 10 Live)

request.description:
Enriches up to 50 keywords in 1 call against the 30-day Keyword Vault (0 credits for misses) or up to 10 keywords live.

Credit Cost: 18 Cr / Hit (0 Cr for Vault Misses)
Cache Policy: 30-Day Vault (50 KWs) / Live (10 KWs)

item.name: GET /api/v1/keywords/golden — Community Golden Gems Feed (Low-KD High-Volume Keywords)

request.description:
Returns trending high-opportunity, low-difficulty Golden Keywords discovered across the SERPSpur ecosystem over the last day or week.

Credit Cost: 5 Credits / Call
Cache Policy: Daily / Weekly Curated Feed

item.name: 4. 7-Engine SERP API
item.description: Fetch live organic search results, SERP features (AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, People Also Ask), and instant target-domain rank matching across 7 global search engines — individually or all in parallel with one POST /api/v1/serp/multi request.

item.name: GET /api/v1/serp — Single-Engine Live SERP & Dynamic Rank Match

request.description:
Fetches organic results, AI Overview detection, and SERP features for a keyword on any of the 7 supported engines. Supplying domain= automatically computes target_domain_rank without extra credits.

Credit Cost: Vault (24h): 3 Cr | Live: 15 Cr
Cache Policy: 24-Hour SERP Vault

item.name: POST /api/v1/serp/multi — Parallel Multi-Engine SERP & Rank Comparison (1–7 Engines)

request.description:
Dispatches up to 7 search engines concurrently in one request and returns side-by-side positions, AI Overview presence, and organic results for every engine.

Credit Cost: 10 Cr / Live Engine (3 Cr if 24h Cached)
Cache Policy: Per-Engine 24h Hybrid

item.name: 5. AI Mentions (GEO) API
item.description: Quantify how often ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews cite and recommend a brand or domain. Returns a normalized 0–100 GEO Visibility Score, per-engine mention & impression splits, self-citation status, top third-party citing domains (e.g. G2, Forbes, Reddit), and recognized brand entities/categories.

item.name: GET /api/v1/ai-mentions — Brand AI Mentions, Citations & GEO Visibility Score

request.description:
Measures brand/domain citations across ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews, returning composite GEO score, per-engine metrics, top citing domains, and recognized entity categories.

Credit Cost: Vault (30d): 15 Cr | Single Engine: 125 Cr | Dual Engine: 245 Cr
Cache Policy: 30-Day GEO Vault

item.name: POST /api/v1/ai-mentions/batch — Batch AI Mentions Vault Lookup (Up to 50 Domains)

request.description:
Checks up to 50 domains in 1 request against the 30-day GEO Vault. Only cache hits consume credits.

Credit Cost: 15 Cr / Vault Hit (0 Cr for Misses)
Cache Policy: 30-Day GEO Vault

item.name: 6. Domain Explorer API
item.description: Get an instant worldwide organic and paid traffic profile for any domain: total monthly organic visits, equivalent paid traffic value in USD, ranking position distribution (Pos 1, 2–3, 4–10, 11–20, 21–50, 51–100), keyword momentum (new/improved/declined/lost), top ranking countries with traffic share %, and zero-cost cross-intelligence across TAI, Backlinks, AI Mentions, and Tech Audit vaults.

item.name: GET /api/v1/domain — Global Domain Traffic, Position Distribution & Top Countries

request.description:
Returns deduplicated worldwide organic & paid traffic metrics, USD valuation, position buckets, keyword velocity, top countries, and cross-intelligence signals.

Credit Cost: Vault (30d): 5 Cr | Live Global Scan: 20 Cr
Cache Policy: 30-Day Domain Vault

item.name: POST /api/v1/domain/batch — Batch Domain Explorer Vault Lookup (Up to 50 Domains)

request.description:
Screens up to 50 domains in one call against the 30-day Domain Explorer Vault. Misses cost 0 credits.

Credit Cost: 5 Cr / Vault Hit (0 Cr for Misses)
Cache Policy: 30-Day Domain Vault

item.name: 7. TAI™ Authenticity API
item.description: Protect link marketplaces, M&A buyers, and media agencies from domains with artificially inflated traffic charts. SERPSpur's proprietary 4-Pillar Traffic Authenticity Index (TAI™) evaluates Intent Authenticity, Referral Hygiene, Authority Equilibrium, and Routing Integrity to output a 0–100 trust score, verified human share %, valuation multiplier, boolean fraud signals, and a verifiable public certificate URL.

item.name: GET /api/v1/tai — Single Domain TAI™ Traffic Authenticity Audit

request.description:
Computes or retrieves the 4-pillar TAI™ score (0–100), risk verdict, verified human vs phantom traffic percentages, fraud risk booleans, and verifiable certificate URL.

Credit Cost: 90-Day Vault: 10 Cr | Live Deep Scan: 50 Cr
Cache Policy: 90-Day TAI Vault

item.name: POST /api/v1/tai/batch — Batch TAI™ Vault Vetting (Up to 50 Domains)

request.description:
Vets up to 50 publisher domains in 1 request against the 90-day TAI™ Vault. Uncached domains return in misses[] at 0 credits.

Credit Cost: 10 Cr / Vault Hit (0 Cr for Misses)
Cache Policy: 90-Day TAI Vault
